summary: Duos Technologies Group filed an 8-K disclosing the September 30, 2026 sale of 100% of Duos Edge AI GPUaaS, LLC to Axe Compute, Inc. under an Equity Purchase Agreement. The SPV held 288 Supermicro B300 servers (2,304 GPUs) plus networking gear. Consideration: Axe repaid roughly $87.8 million of SPV debt and owes a deferred purchase price of $715,000 per month for 60 months, accelerated to the earlier of 12 months post-closing or new cluster-secured financing. The deal removes about $98.1 million of prospective equipment financing; no board recommendation or advisor is named. Watch deferred-payment credit risk and acceleration triggers.
